# Message pagination arms its deadline before awaiting the next search check

When a query already has results on its current page and autoPaginationTimeout is positive, searchMessages schedules addPage before awaiting the next criteria check. The remaining delay is measured from the first result on that page. A pending asynchronous check can therefore let the current page finish without waiting for that message. The normal path clears the timer and awaits a triggered addPage; tests separately assert page counts and elapsed minimums. This is source inspection, without a deadline or failure-recovery runtime guarantee.

Scope: WebExtension message pagination.
